actions: UTF-16 selection/replace/undo/redo; split-surrogate rejection; keyboard grapheme navigation/deletion; readonly and beforeinput-cancelled fields (typing, paste, programmatic); fcitx5 pinyin in text/email/textarea/password/readonly; programmatic focus; focus change mid-composition; Escape
expected: Correct UTF-16/grapheme editing, history, cancellation and real IME
observed: Selections round-trip with direction; split offsets rejected with state unchanged; replace + undo/redo exact; caret stops 1,2,4,5,6,8,9; Backspace/Delete remove whole graphemes; cancel-field rejects typing/paste/programmatic replace (beforeinput default_prevented); pinyin commits 你好 in text/email/textarea; password keeps the IME off; readonly unchanged; programmatic focus enables the IME; focus change keeps "zhong" in t2 and the next composition goes to mail ("问"); Escape cancels
limitations: A composition interrupted by a focus change stays in its own field (browser behaviour, required by the finish instructions)
